completedTasks.summary: Retrieval benchmark for embedding-model comparison (BenchmarkDotNet project at benchmarks/AiRaccoon.Benchmarks). Backends are official packages behind Microsoft.Extensions.AI IEmbeddingGenerator: local GGUF via LLamaSharp (adapter over GetEmbeddings — 0.27's interface GenerateAsync touches a disposed handle), LM Studio via OpenAI SDK AsIEmbeddingGenerator; cosine via BCL TensorPrimitives. Quality metrics Recall@5/Recall@10/MRR/nDCG@10 + BenchmarkDotNet latency. Real-world corpus (default): 174 docs verbatim from job-search-ai-assistant/ai-badger/arasz-home-page ADRs, invariants, skills + .remember notes, 68 queries with // judgment relevance comments; generator scripts/generate-benchmark-corpus.py (idempotent, read-only over sources). --synthetic keeps the 48-doc regression set. Results (macos-arm64, LM Studio on 192.168.50.102): real corpus differentiates models — EmbeddingGemma-300m leads (R@5 0.343, nDCG 0.704), all-MiniLM 0.325/0.607, qwen3 0.326/0.606; local in-process ~9ms/query vs 37-90ms network. Subagent research: Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation libraries skipped (LLM-judge text-quality, no Recall@K; documented in README). Merged to main.

Researched and shipped the small local GGUF embedding model for AIRACCOON_TEST_GGUF. Verified all-MiniLM-L6-v2 Q5_K_M (~21 MB, Apache-2.0) end-to-end against sqlite-memory 1.3.5's llama.cpp local engine (nomic-embed-text-v1.5 Q8_0 ~139 MB documented as the reference alternative). scripts/download-embedding-model.sh pins SHA-256 and installs under <data-root>/models/. Running the previously-skipped embedding tests uncovered + fixed a real Dapper bug: memory_search's blob-affinity columns defeated record-ctor matching (now a settable SearchRow DTO). With AIRACCOON_TEST_GGUF set, all 185 tests pass with 0 skips. Docs document the honest engine matrix: local (provider=local + GGUF path) and vectors.space remote (provider=openai + key); LM Studio/Ollama are NOT configurable — the pinned extension hardcodes the vectors.space URL. Everything merged to main.

Applied 4 review-feedback items + 2 follow-ups + E2E test expansion on agent-memory-server. (1) TimeProvider injected into MetaStore/SweepService (UtcNow eliminated in prod; TimeProvider.System in DI; deterministic FakeTimeProvider tests). (2) Custom Guard.cs deleted; all guards are CommunityToolkit.Diagnostics; redundant ctor null-checks removed (NRT + DI guarantee non-null). (3) FluentValidation nested validators in SearchQuery/MemoryWriteRequest, invoked at the MCP boundary, camelCase property paths (ADR-0001). (4) Workspace begin/close records persisted in the meta DB via IWorkspaceStore/SqliteWorkspaceStore for crash traceability. f: high-perf LoggerMessage logging replaces Console.Error; official FakeTimeProvider/FakeLogger packages. e: xunit traits (Category Unit/Integration/E2E + Speed Fast/Slow, filterable) + E2E suite over WebApplicationFactory+McpClient (save, worktree lifecycle, isolation, move-to-shared, sync-not-configured, embeddings). E2E exposed+fixed a real bug: SyncOptions was never registered in DI. 182 tests, build 0 warnings.

Enabled all 8 opt-in ai-badger skills (config.include.skills + scaffold on master: debug-issue, evidence-first-research, explore-codebase, migrate-documentation, refactor-safely, review-changes, scaffold-documentation, update-documentation); scaffolded canonical docs/ tree (README compass + per-directory READMEs per scaffold-documentation skill); rewrote root README.md and added LICENSE (MIT) + SECURITY.md adapted from ai-badger repo templates; .gitignore hygiene (.DS_Store, __pycache__).

Unit test project (xunit.v3+Shouldly, 13 cases) for RandomNumberTools; dual stdio/http MCP transport via MCP_TRANSPORT; local NuGet feed deploy gated on dotnet_env=local; publish profile, launch settings, central versions.

Agent memory management MCP server over sqlite-memory: Core domain (records, RatingPolicy, DegradationPolicy, IMemoryExtension + MemoryExtensionHost pipeline, SearchScope), Infrastructure (one SQLite bank per install scope, SqliteMemoryStore via Dapper, MetaStore rating, WorkspaceService, SweepService, ExtensionProvisioner with real SHA-256 manifest, SyncService), thin MCP layer (17 tools + 2 prompts, dual transport). Workspace sandboxes (workspace_id = isolation by design, no flag), shared promotion tier (memory_share via path-scoped hashes, sweep-exempt), deferred embeddings by default (FR-MEM-1.12), opt-in SQLite Cloud sync of committed contexts. Real-extension integration tests against sqlite-memory 1.3.5 + sqlite-vector 1.0.0. 168 tests, build 0 warnings.

stillTrue: dotnet_env=local must be set per-directory for the DeployToLocalSource build target to push to .nupkg-local
MCP_TRANSPORT=http selects the Streamable HTTP transport at /mcp; anything else runs stdio
sqlite-memory's content-hash dedup is global — cross-context duplicates need preserve_duplicate_paths=1 + distinct logical paths
Dapper 2.1.79 parameter binding is case-sensitive against SQL param names and its record ctor matching chokes on nullable params — alias columns and use a settable DTO
sqlite-memory/vector/sync are native SQLite extensions loaded via Microsoft.Data.Sqlite LoadExtension; deferred embeddings (defer_embeddings=1) let writes work before any model is configured
The E2E server boot requires AIRACCOON_DATA_ROOT + MCP_TRANSPORT env set BEFORE host build; E2E tests mutate env so they run in a serial collection
MCP protocol CallToolResult.IsError is null on success (absent), true only on failure — assert ShouldNotBe(true), not ShouldBe(false)
